data.name: Lakhvinder
data.gender_notes: Lakhvinder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lakh means 'hundred thousands' and Vinder means 'conqueror' or 'finder'. This name signifies the power of wealth and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, blesses the one with this name with abundance and prosperity. The name Lakhvinder carries the meaning “Wealth, Prosperity, Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lakhvinder usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth, prosperity, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May you be blessed with the divine grace of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
data.etymology: Lakhvinder belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealth, Prosperity, Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lakhvinder total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
